# superset_group (Resource)

Manages a group in Superset.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "superset_group" "example_group" {
  name  = "Data Team"
  roles = [3, 4]
  users = [10, 20]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the group.
- `roles` (List of Number) List of role IDs assigned to the group.
- `users` (List of Number) List of user IDs assigned to the group.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Numeric identifier of the group.
- `last_updated` (String) Timestamp of the last update.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Group can be imported by specifying the numeric identifier of the Group id
terraform import superset_group.example_group 50
```
